20model%20uses%20all%20the%20frames%20at%20once%20to%20estimate%20one%20parameter%2C%20which%20is%20why%20it%20is%20so%20much%20more%20precise%20than%20any%20derivative.%20The%20price%20is%20that%20you%20must%20trust%20the%20model.%0A%0A%20%20%20%20Look%20again%20at%20the%20central-difference%20vertical%20acceleration%3A%20it%20drifts%20from%20about%20%24-9.7%24%20to%20almost%20%24-11%24%20m%2Fs%C2%B2%20over%20the%20last%20frames%2C%20which%20no%20ball%20in%20free%20flight%20does.%20Something%20is%20wrong%20with%20the%20last%20frames%2C%20perhaps%20a%20distortion%20of%20the%20lens%20near%20the%20edge%20of%20the%20video%20image%2C%20or%20the%20ball%20moving%20out%20of%20the%20plane%20of%20the%20camera.%20Leaving%20out%20the%20last%20four%20frames%20changes%20%24g%24%20by%20about%200.1%20m%2Fs%C2%B2.%20To%20read%20more%20about%20fitting%20a%20model%20to%20data%2C%20see%20%5BCurve%20fitting%5D(https%3A%2F%2Fmolab.marimo.io%2Fgithub%2FBMClab%2FBMC%2Fblob%2Fmaster%2Fnotebooks%2Fcurve_fitting.py).%0A%20%20%20%20%22%22%22)%0A%20%20%20%20return%0A%0A%0A%40app.cell(hide_code%3DTrue)%0Adef%20_(mo)%3A%0A%20%20%20%20mo.md(r%22%22%22%0A%20%20%20%20%23%23%20The%20optimal%20cutoff%20frequency%0A%0A%20%20%20%20You%20are%20probably%20now%20wondering%20how%20to%20determine%20automatically%20the%20optimal%20cutoff%20frequency%20of%20a%20low-pass%20filter%2C%20the%20one%20that%20attenuates%20as%20much%20of%20the%20noise%20as%20possible%20without%20compromising%20the%20signal.%20This%20is%20an%20important%20topic%20in%20signal%20processing%2C%20particularly%20in%20movement%20science%2C%20and%20one%20method%20for%20it%20is%20the%20subject%20of%20the%20notebook%20%5BResidual%20analysis%20to%20determine%20the%20optimal%20cutoff%20frequency%5D(https%3A%2F%2Fmolab.marimo.io%2Fgithub%2FBMClab%2FBMC%2Fblob%2Fmaster%2Fnotebooks%2Fresidual_analysis.py).%0A%20%20%20%20%22%22%22)%0A%20%20%20%20return%0A%0A%0A%40app.cell(hide_code%3DTrue)%0Adef%20_(mo)%3A%0A%20%20%20%20mo.md(r%22%22%22%0A%20%20%20%20**Exercise%208.**%20Why%20can%20a%20quadratic%20fit%20estimate%20gravity%20from%20a%20short%20ball%20flight%20more%20reliably%20than%20two%20numerical%20differences%3F%20What%20would%20invalidate%20that%20fit%3F%0A%0A%20%20%20%20%2F%2F%2F%20details%20%7C%20Solution%20to%20Exercise%208%0A%20%20%20%20A%20quadratic%20uses%20the%20constant-acceleration%20model%20to%20combine%20all%20frames%20into%20three%20coefficients%3B%20its%20acceleration%20is%20the%20constant%20%242p_2%24.%20Differencing%20instead%20magnifies%20local%20tracking%20errors.%20The%20model%20fails%20if%20drag%2C%20camera%20perspective%2C%20out-of-plane%20motion%20or%20contact%20forces%20matter.%20A%20small%20fit%20residual%20alone%20cannot%20establish%20the%20model%E2%80%99s%20physical%20validity.%0A%20%20%20%20%2F%2F%2F%0A%20%20%20%20%22%22%22)%0A%20%20%20%20return%0A%0A%0A%40app.cell(hide_code%3DTrue)%0Adef%20_(mo)%3A%0A%20%20%20%20mo.md(r%22%22%22%0A%20%20%20%20%23%23%20Checkpoint%20questions%0A%0A%20%20%20%20Pause%20here%20before%20the%20problems.%0A%0A%20%20%20%201.%20Go%20back%20to%20your%20guess%20in%20Challenge%200.%20By%20what%20factor%20does%20each%20differentiation%20multiply%20a%20noise%20component%20at%20frequency%20%24f%24%3F%20What%20does%20that%20mean%20for%20noise%20near%20the%20Nyquist%20frequency%20of%20a%20100%20Hz%20recording%3F%0A%20%20%20%202.%20A%20single-pass%20Butterworth%20filter%20at%206%20Hz%20is%20applied%20to%20a%20marker%20trajectory%20but%20not%20to%20the%20EMG%20recorded%20with%20it.%20What%20happens%20to%20the%20timing%20between%20muscle%20activation%20and%20movement%3F%0A%20%20%20%203.%20Why%20must%20the%20cutoff%20frequency%20be%20corrected%20when%20filtering%20with%20%60filtfilt%60%3F%20What%20do%20you%20report%20in%20your%20methods%20if%20you%20forget%3F%0A%20%20%20%204.%20When%20would%20you%20prefer%20a%20critically%20damped%20filter%20to%20a%20Butterworth%20filter%3F%0A%20%20%20%205.%20Why%20can%20%60filtfilt%60%20not%20be%20used%20to%20filter%20data%20in%20real%20time%2C%20for%20instance%20in%20a%20biofeedback%20system%3F%0A%20%20%20%206.%20The%20ball%20toss%20was%20solved%20by%20fitting%20a%20model%2C%20the%20Pezzack%20data%20by%20filtering.%20When%20is%20each%20approach%20appropriate%3F%0A%20%20%20%20%22%22%22)%0A%20%20%20%20return%0A%0A%0A%40app.cell(hide_code%3DTrue)%0Adef%20_(mo)%3A%0A%20%20%20%20mo.md(r%22%22%22%0A%20%20%20%20%2F%2F%2F%20details%20%7C%20Checkpoint%20answers%0A%20%20%20%201.%20Continuous%20differentiation%20multiplies%20amplitude%20by%20%242%5Cpi%20f%24.%20For%20the%20discrete%20second%20difference%2C%20the%20exact%20magnitude%20is%20%244f_s%5E2%5Csin%5E2(%5Cpi%20f%2Ff_s)%24%3B%20it%20is%20large%20near%20Nyquist%20and%20only%20approaches%20%24(2%5Cpi%20f)%5E2%24%20at%20low%20frequency.%0A%20%20%20%202.%20The%20filtered%20marker%20trajectory%20lags%20by%20a%20frequency-dependent%20amount%2C%20biasing%20comparison%20with%20the%20unfiltered%20EMG.%0A%20%20%20%203.%20Two%20passes%20square%20the%20amplitude%20response.%20Report%20the%20design%20cutoff%2C%20order%20per%20pass%2C%20number%20of%20passes%20and%20effective%20response%3B%20do%20not%20label%20the%20uncorrected%20design%20frequency%20as%20the%20combined%20%24-3%24%20dB%20cutoff.%0A%20%20%20%204.%20When%20avoiding%20step%20ringing%20matters%20more%20than%20a%20sharp%20frequency%20transition%2C%20after%20checking%20the%20actual%20digital%20response.%0A%20%20%20%205.%20The%20backward%20pass%20needs%20future%20samples%20from%20the%20whole%20record.%0A%20%20%20%206.%20Fit%20a%20model%20when%20its%20physical%20assumptions%20are%20justified%3B%20use%20filtering%20when%20an%20appropriate%20signal%2Fnoise%20separation%20is%20defensible%20without%20prescribing%20the%20whole%20trajectory.%0A%20%20%20%20%2F%2F%2F%0A%20%20%20%20%22%22%22)%0A%20%20%20%20return%0A%0A%0A%40app.cell(hide_code%3DTrue)%0Adef%20_(mo)%3A%0A%20%20%20%20mo.md(r%22%22%22%0A%20%20%20%20%23%23%20Problems%0A%0A%20%20%20%201.%20Show%20that%20the%20coefficients%20of%20the%20moving-average%20filter%20satisfy%20%24%5Csum%20b_k%20-%20%5Csum_%7Bk%20%5Cgeq%201%7D%20a_k%20%3D%201%24.%20What%20does%20this%20property%20mean%20for%20a%20constant%20input%3F%0A%0A%20%20%20%202.%20Use%20%60signal.freqz%60%20to%20plot%20the%20frequency%20response%20of%20moving-average%20filters%20of%205%20and%2011%20samples%2C%20for%20data%20sampled%20at%20100%20Hz.%20At%20what%20frequency%20is%20the%20first%20zero%20of%20each%20response%3F%20Is%20the%20moving%20average%20a%20good%20low-pass%20filter%3F%20Compare%20it%20with%20a%20second-order%20Butterworth%20filter%20whose%20%24-3%24%20dB%20point%20matches%20the%20moving%20average%E2%80%99s%20%24-3%24%20dB%20point%20(not%20its%20first%20zero).%0A%0A%20%20%20%203.%20A%20high-pass%20filter%20attenuates%20low%20frequencies%20and%20passes%20high%20frequencies.%20Remove%20the%20DC%20component%20and%20any%20slow%20drift%20of%20the%20EMG%20above%20with%20a%20second-order%20Butterworth%20high-pass%20filter%20at%2020%20Hz.%20Compare%20the%20result%20with%20simply%20subtracting%20the%20mean.%0A%0A%20%20%20%204.%20The%20linear%20envelope%20of%20an%20EMG%20is%20obtained%20by%20full-wave%20rectifying%20it%20(taking%20its%20absolute%20value)%20and%20filtering%20it%20with%20a%20low-pass%20filter%20at%20a%20few%20hertz.%20Compute%20the%20linear%20envelope%20of%20the%20EMG%20above%20with%20a%20zero-phase%20Butterworth%20filter%20at%205%20Hz%2C%20and%20compare%20it%20with%20the%20moving%20RMS.%20See%20%5BElectromyography%5D(https%3A%2F%2Fmolab.marimo.io%2Fgithub%2FBMClab%2FBMC%2Fblob%2Fmaster%2Fnotebooks%2Felectromyography.py).%0A%0A%20%20%20%205.%20Filter%20the%20vertical%20position%20of%20the%20ball%20toss%20with%20a%20zero-phase%20Butterworth%20low-pass%20filter%2C%20differentiate%20it%20twice%2C%20and%20compare%20the%20acceleration%20with%20the%20%24g%24%20estimated%20by%20the%20polynomial%20fit.%20Which%20cutoff%20frequency%20did%20you%20use%2C%20and%20why%20is%20filtering%20harder%20here%20than%20with%20the%20Pezzack%20data%3F%0A%0A%20%20%20%206.%20Repeat%20the%20comparison%20of%20the%20Butterworth%2C%20Savitzky-Golay%20and%20spline%20methods%20with%20the%20noisy%20version%20of%20Pezzack's%20angle%2C%20%60pz_disp_noisy%60%2C%20adjusting%20the%20parameters%20of%20each%20method.%20Does%20the%20ranking%20of%20the%20methods%20change%3F%0A%20%20%20%20%22%22%22)%0A%20%20%20%20return%0A%0A%0A%40app.cell(hide_code%3DTrue)%0Adef%20_(mo)%3A%0A%20%20%20%20mo.md(r%22%22%22%0A%20%20%20%20%2F%2F%2F%20details%20%7C%20Final%20answers%0A%20%20%20%201.%20%24b_k%3D1%2Fm%24%20for%20%24k%3D0%2C%5Cldots%2Cm-1%24%20and%20all%20feedback%20coefficients%20are%20zero%2C%20so%20the%20expression%20is%201.%20A%20constant%20input%20is%20preserved%20away%20from%20initialization%2Fpadding%20boundaries.%0A%0A%20%20%20%202.%20First%20zeros%3A%2020%20Hz%20for%205%20samples%20and%20%24100%2F11%5Capprox9.0909%24%20Hz%20for%2011%20samples.%20Their%20single-pass%20%24-3%24%20dB%20points%20are%20approximately%209.0159%20and%204.0412%20Hz.%20A%20matched%20Butterworth%20response%20decreases%20monotonically%3B%20the%20moving%20average%20has%20sidelobes%20and%20passes%20some%20higher-frequency%20components%2C%20so%20it%20is%20a%20limited%20low-pass%20filter.%0A%0A%20%20%20%203.%20Mean%20subtraction%20removes%20only%20DC.%20A%2020%20Hz%20high-pass%20also%20attenuates%20slow%20fluctuations%20and%20movement%20artifacts%3B%20a%20single%20pass%20changes%20phase%2C%20and%20two%20uncorrected%20passes%20give%20%24-6.02%24%20dB%20at%2020%20Hz.%20High-frequency%20EMG%20remains%2C%20subject%20to%20the%20chosen%20response.%0A%0A%20%20%20%204.%20Both%20estimates%20follow%20the%20burst%20timing.%20The%20rectified-and-smoothed%20envelope%20estimates%20local%20mean%20absolute%20amplitude%3B%20RMS%20estimates%20the%20square%20root%20of%20local%20mean%20square%2C%20so%20their%20amplitudes%20are%20not%20interchangeable.%20For%20locally%20zero-mean%20Gaussian%20amplitude%20distributions%2C%20mean%20absolute%20amplitude%20is%20%24%5Csqrt%7B2%2F%5Cpi%7D%5Capprox0.798%24%20times%20RMS.%20Different%20windows%20and%20edge%20handling%20give%20further%20differences.%0A%0A%20%20%20%205.%20One%20defensible%20illustrative%20choice%20is%20a%20corrected%203%20Hz%20two-pass%20Butterworth%20filter.%20Its%20acceleration%20is%20not%20constant%20and%20its%20endpoints%20are%20especially%20distorted.%20The%20quadratic%20estimates%20are%20%24g%3D-9.9781%24%20m%2Fs%C2%B2%20for%20all%2022%20frames%20and%20%24g%3D-9.8720%24%20m%2Fs%C2%B2%20without%20the%20last%20four.%20This%20record%20is%20only%20about%200.7%20s%20long%2C%20so%20boundaries%20and%20model%20violations%20matter%20much%20more%20than%20in%20the%20longer%20Pezzack%20record%3B%20no%20unique%20data-only%20cutoff%20is%20justified.%0A%0A%20%20%20%206.%20A%20reproducible%20tuned%20comparison%20using%20RMSE%20on%20the%20common%20interior%20samples%2C%20odd%20padding%20of%2011%20samples%20for%20polynomial%20methods%2C%20and%20the%20grids%20specified%20here%20gives%20approximately%3A%20Butterworth%20cutoff%205.1%20Hz%2C%20RMSE%204.51%20rad%2Fs%C2%B2%3B%20Savitzky%E2%80%93Golay%20window%2015%2Forder%204%2C%20RMSE%204.59%3B%20quintic%20spline%20%24s%5Capprox0.00545247%24%2C%20RMSE%204.24.%20For%20the%20cleaner%20angle%2C%20a%20tuned%20spline%20is%20also%20slightly%20best%20(about%204.05)%2C%20followed%20by%20Savitzky%E2%80%93Golay%20(4.14)%20and%20Butterworth%20(4.16).%20Thus%20this%20tuning%20does%20not%20reverse%20the%20ranking.%20These%20are%20benchmark-specific%20comparisons%2C%20not%20general%20superiority%20claims.%20The%20search%20grids%20are%20cutoff%202%E2%80%9318%20Hz%20in%200.1%20Hz%20steps%2C%20odd%20Savitzky%E2%80%93Golay%20windows%205%E2%80%9323%2Forders%202%E2%80%934%2C%20and%20spline%20%24s%3Dk%5C%2C%5Cmathrm%7Bvar%7D(x_%7Bpad%7D)%2FN_%7Bpad%7D%24%20with%2081%20logarithmically%20spaced%20%24k%24%20values%20from%200.01%20to%20100.%0A%20%20%20%20%2F%2F%2F%0A%20%20%20%20%22%22%22)%0A%20%20%20%20return%0A%0A%0A%40app.cell(hide_code%3DTrue)%0Adef%20_(mo)%3A%0A%20%20%20%20mo.md(r%22%22%2
